note: Literature confirms variation in cerebellar atrophy on MRI ranging from severe atrophy in some TUBA4A cohorts to slight or absent atrophy in patients with p.Glu415Lys.

evidence.text: Torella et al. report spastic ataxia associated with the novel p.Glu415Lys variant in TUBA4A exhibiting slight or absent cerebellar atrophy on neuroimaging.

source.title: A new genetic cause of spastic ataxia: the p.Glu415Lys variant in TUBA4A

evidence.text: Benkirane et al. identified ultra-rare TUBA4A missense variants causing spastic ataxia characterized by variable age of onset and severe cerebellar atrophy.

source.title: De novo and inherited monoallelic variants in TUBA4A cause ataxia and spasticity
source.quote: ataxia associated with severe cerebellar atrophy and cerebellar cognitive and

numbers.metric: reported patients with spasticity and/or cerebellar ataxia
